editorial: We visited in early June. Athens was pleasant, while Santorini was heating up both in celsius and crowds. And we recommend visiting around this time to have an optimal experience.

seasons.title: APRIL TO JUNE
editorial: Spring / early summer is NOT the most popular time to visit, which is exactly why we recommend it.
Santorini felt crowded as it is during the shoulder season, and we can’t begin to imagine what it must be like during the summer peak.

seasons.title: JULY & AUGUST
editorial: Don’t. Just don’t. Unless you really want to party, in which case, you may actually appreciate the crowds.

seasons.title: SEPTEMBER & OCTOBER
editorial: Warm seas and thinning crowds make early autumn is a pretty good time to visit as well.
One word of caution though - You may find that the hospitality workers are exhausted from the summer rush, so the quality of service may be ever so slightly worse than in spring / early summer.

seasons.title: NOVEMBER TO MARCH
editorial: Winter is low season, which means a lot of businesses in the Aegean islands shut shop. Athens alone is not enough of a draw to visit Greece, so we’d avoid this time.
